applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Luke 2:48-49 counts by saying it was answered in named rounds, which triggers K-G4's instruction about answered verses.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge expressly says the verse was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness, so it does not breach K-G4.
